# Monocypher

Ed25519 signature verification for the release key (`Frameworks/signing`).

Source: https://github.com/LoupVaillant/Monocypher, tag `4.0.2`, commit `0d85f98c9d9b0227e42cf795cb527dff372b40a4`. The files under `src/` are copied unchanged from that commit:

- `src/monocypher.c`, `src/monocypher.h`
- `src/optional/monocypher-ed25519.c`, `src/optional/monocypher-ed25519.h`

Monocypher is dual-licensed under the 2-clause BSD licence and CC0; see `LICENCE.md`.

To update, copy the same four files from a new release tag and record the tag and commit here.
